ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/grey) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region originates at the peduncle and extends to the median notch. High-intensity lobes are positioned laterally, featuring low-intensity mottling concentrated near the medial base and along the superior-trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute-angled V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 70 degrees and a distinct pixel-depth relative to the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations with peaks and valleys; right lobe displays a significant indentation or missing segment approximately one-third lateral from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing boundary follows a sigmoidal curve, exhibiting concavity at the medial junction and transitioning to convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity circular pixel nodes are visible on the lateral tips and at discrete points along the trailing edge peaks of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel tracks (rake marks) are detected; specifically, parallel diagonal marks on the mid-left lobe and prominent vertical/oblique marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of parallel rake-mark abrasions on both lobes and significant barnacle encrustations on the distal tips.
